title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
reason: New congressional letters expanding oversight hearings into the administration and crypto collateral are a substantive regulatory development with documented sources.

sources.summary: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
reason: Elliptic's analysis of $247 million in laundering from the Binance hack is a significant, sourced development on a major security breach.

sources.summary: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.
